stabilizer_parity_and_projection_receipt.author: @vprusso

comparison_family.definition: Binary ordinary two-circulant UB(a,ell): b=a^(2^ell) modulo x^337+1
comparison_family.reason: The modulus is square-free, so gcd(a^(2^ell),modulus)=gcd(a,modulus); both projections and the full row space have equal rank.

parity_obstruction.UB_all_stabilizers_even_reason: CSS row spaces contain only even vectors; orthogonality makes their intersection even; mixed-Pauli weight is the union size.
parity_obstruction.invariant: Pauli support weight is preserved by tensor products of single-qubit Cliffords and qubit permutations

stabilizer_parity_and_projection_receipt.theorem_conclusion: No tensor product of arbitrary single-qubit Clifford gates followed by a qubit permutation maps this code to any ordinary 674-qubit Frobenius UB code.
limits: No inequivalence claim for arbitrary entangling Clifford circuits
No distance lower bound or hardware-performance claim
Projection-rank inequality is not X/Z distance asymmetry; the GB involution exchanges sectors.
